sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG team,

thank you for your message. Your letter (doc:20260911-70110-P01) gives 51 days' notice, while our contract (ctr:4600070110) requires 90 days. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06). Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 127.31, effective_date 2027-01-01, payment_days 14; unit_price 127.18, effective_date 2026-11-01, payment_days 14; unit_price 127.64, effective_date 2027-04-01, payment_days 14). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €138.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
As to the index change and notice period data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains.
We have also factored in the energy index data you provided, allowing us to revise our price to €135.30 per unit.
We accept your proposed 14-day payment terms as part of this updated offer.
Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: €135.30 per unit.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Our standard terms apply to everything the quote does not state; see attached.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We have already taken that index change data into account, and we have already taken that notice period data into account. The data you cited was already factored into our previous concession, but in recognition of your improved offer, we are willing to make another step.

For our primary proposal, we present a price of €136.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer is valid for 30 days.

As an alternative, we propose a revised price of €133.90 per unit for a start date of 1 January 2027 with 14 payment days. This alternative option offers a price of €133.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027.

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your improved offer and are willing to make another step towards you.

Regarding the details of our calculations, we have already taken that index change data into account. Furthermore, the notice period data you cited again has already been fully accounted for in our previous concessions. 

With these adjustments in mind, we can now offer €135.70 per unit for a start date of 1 April 2027 with 14 days payment terms. To confirm the specifics of our Angebot, this comprises a price of €135.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value the long relationship between our companies deeply, and we look forward to continuing our collaboration.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
